entries.title: Genesis 13:1
segments: ¶Then Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, to the South.

entries.title: Genesis 13:2
segments: Abram [was] very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

entries.title: Genesis 13:3
segments: And he went on his journey from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

entries.title: Genesis 13:4
segments: to the place of the altar which he had made there at first. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 13:5
segments: ¶Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks and herds and tents.

entries.title: Genesis 13:6
segments: Now the land was not able to support them, that they might dwell together, for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.

entries.title: Genesis 13:7
segments: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites then dwelt in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 13:8
segments: So Abram said to Lot, "Please let there be no strife between you and me, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we [are] brethren.

entries.title: Genesis 13:9
segments: "[Is] not the whole land before you? Please separate from me. If [you take] the left, then I will go to the right; or, if [you go] to the right, then I will go to the left."

entries.title: Genesis 13:10
segments: ¶And Lot lifted his eyes and saw all the plain of Jordan, that it [was] well watered everywhere (before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah) like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt as you go toward Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 13:11
segments: Then Lot chose for himself all the plain of Jordan, and Lot journeyed east. And they separated from each other.

entries.title: Genesis 13:12
segments: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain and pitched [his] tent even as far as Sodom.

entries.title: Genesis 13:13
segments: But the men of Sodom [were] exceedingly wicked and sinful against the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 13:14
segments: ¶And the LORD said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him: "Lift your eyes now and look from the place where you are-northward, southward, eastward, and westward;

entries.title: Genesis 13:15
segments: "for all the land which you see I give to you and your descendants forever.

entries.title: Genesis 13:16
segments: "And I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; so that if a man could number the dust of the earth, [then] your descendants also could be numbered.

entries.title: Genesis 13:17
segments: "Arise, walk in the land through its length and its width, for I give it to you."

entries.title: Genesis 13:18
segments: Then Abram moved [his] tent, and went and dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre, which [are] in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.
